dedupe_keys.name: an inventory of industrial solid waste in 337 cities of china applying machine learning for data completion

description: An inventory of industrial solid waste in 337 cities of China: Applying machine learning for data completion is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Qian Jia et al. Rapid industrialization of China generated a massive quantity of waste, among them industrial solid waste contributed the biggest flow to some 60 gigatonnes (Gt) in the past two decades. A complete tempo-spatial dataset of industrial waste, however, is absent in many areas in China, due to numerous waste producers and insufficient statistical coverage. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 311533 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
